Pull request
checks only, never deploys

span.p:
State bucket
created once by hand

div.style: color: rgb(17, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · checks
no AWS access, fails fast
ruff check app
terraform fmt -check
terraform validate -backend=false

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
a · registries
terraform apply -target
aws_ecr_repository.api
aws_ecr_repository.ingest

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
b · two images
app/api/Dockerfile -> api repo
app/ingestion/Dockerfile -> ingest repo
context is the repo root
both tagged with the commit SHA

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
c · workloads
terraform apply, full
TF_VAR_image_tag=SHA
then wait services-stable

div.style: color: rgb(17, 32, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
d · corpus
aws s3 sync --delete
invoke Lambda reindex
fail if 0 passages indexed

div.style: color: rgb(17, 48, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · smoke
/health returns 200
/ready shows index_exists
a real question returns citations

div.style: color: rgb(58, 42, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 49, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Why the split
Terraform creates the ECR repositories, but the ECS
service and the Lambda both reference an image tag
inside them. A single apply would fail on first run,
because the tags do not exist yet.
